definitions.gloss: to train thoroughly; to forge completely; to hone to perfection
definitions.explanation: to train someone or something to the highest level of skill or fitness through intensive effort

examples.japanese: ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{鍛|きた}え{上|あ}げる。
⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧{鍛|きた}え{上|あ}げた⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧。
⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}→練習：05323_renshuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{鍛|きた}え{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I built up my body through rigorous training.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)

COMPOUND VERB:
⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧ (to train/forge) + ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ (to finish/complete)
The ⟦{上|あ}げる→上げる：02443_ageru⟧ adds the nuance of completion or bringing to a high level.

OBJECTS:
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧/⟦{肉体|にくたい}→肉体：13912_nikutai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{鍛|きた}え{上|あ}げる (to build up one's body)
- ⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧/⟦{腕|うで}→腕：01006_ude⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{鍛|きた}え{上|あ}げる (to hone skills)
- ⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{鍛|きた}え{上|あ}げる (to train athletes thoroughly)

USAGE:
Implies bringing training to completion or perfection, not just regular practice.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{鍛|きた}える→鍛える：12326_kitaeru⟧ (to train, to forge)
- ⟦{磨|みが}き{上|あ}げる→磨き上げる：08248_migakiageru⟧ (to polish up)
- ⟦{仕上|しあ}げる→仕上げる：04664_shiageru⟧ (to finish, to complete)
